title: Wake Up
message: You are not lost. You are becoming.

title: Peace
message: God is still shaping you. Keep walking in faith.

title: Truth
message: Your life still has purpose, even in the process.

title: Hope
message: Your dreams are not dead. They are waiting for action.

title: Love
message: Love yourself enough to grow, heal, and rise.

title: Purpose
message: You are here to leave impact, not just survive.

title: Grace
message: You do not have to carry everything alone. God is with you.

title: Strength
message: Your next step may be small, but it is still progress.

title: Focus
message: Stay rooted in peace, truth, and purpose.
